title: Analytical Provisioning for Attention-FFN Disaggregated LLM Serving under Stochastic Workloads
abstract: arXiv:2601.21351v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Attentio-FFN disaggregation (AFD) is an emerging architecture for LLM decoding that separates state-heavy, KV-cache-dominated Attention computation from stateless, compute-intensive FFN computation, connected by per-step communication. While AFD enables independent scaling of memory and compute resources, its performance is highly sensitive to the Attention/FFN provisioning ratio: mis-sizing induces step-level blocking and costly device idle time. We develop an analytical provisioning framework for AFD bundles in an $r$A--$1$F topology under stochastic workloads. Two sources of randomness shape the problem: per-slot Attention workload evolves as KV caches grow and completed requests are replenished with random prompt and decode lengths, and synchronized execution across Attention workers introduces a barrier governed by the slowest worker. translated_title: 随机工作负载下注意力-FFN分离式LLM服务的分析性资源配置
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2601.21351v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：注意力-FFN分离（AFD）是一种新兴的LLM解码架构，它将状态密集、以KV缓存为主的注意力计算与无状态、计算密集的FFN计算分离，并通过逐步通信连接。虽然AFD支持内存和计算资源的独立扩展，但其性能对注意力/FFN资源配置比例高度敏感：错误的大小配置会导致逐步阻塞和昂贵的设备空闲时间。我们开发了一个在随机工作负载下，针对$r$A--$1$F拓扑中AFD捆绑包的分析性资源配置框架。两个随机性来源塑造了该问题：每时隙注意力工作负载随KV缓存增长而演变，完成的请求以随机提示和解码长度补充，以及注意力工作器间的同步执行引入了一个由最慢工作器主导的屏障。我们通过更新-奖励特征化来处理这两点，以解决每时隙的平稳令牌负载。
tldr: 本文提出了一个分析性框架，用于在随机工作负载下优化注意力-FFN分离架构的资源配置比例，以最小化设备空闲时间并提高LLM服务效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an analytical framework to optimize the attention-FFN provisioning ratio under stochastic workloads in disaggregated LLM serving, minimizing device idle time and improving efficiency.
